children: Overview
Hong Kong media platform maker's interim revenue grew 2.6% yr/yr to HK$231.2 mln
Company posted HK$22.1 mln loss attributable to owners, narrowing from prior year
Gross profit margin declined due to higher material costs and global chip shortages
Outlook
Company is exploring new business opportunities in emerging markets and other sectors
Result Drivers
HIGHER MATERIAL COSTS - Co said increased material costs and global chip shortages led to lower gross profit margin
SEGMENT REVENUE GROWTH - Media entertainment platform products segment revenue rose 45% yr/yr as co explored new business opportunities in emerging markets
CHINA-US TRADE WAR IMPACT - Co said ongoing China-US trade tensions had negative impacts on some operations, but mitigated by sourcing from suppliers in Southeast Asia
